scope: Thirty-two explicitly chosen everyday noun senses in all 110 directions: 8,320 exact case-form unit records and 1,980 equivalent-sense description repairs of existing bounded frames.

decisions.topics: Food, money, telephone device, friend, residential house, school, office, meeting, passenger bus, railway train, airport, hotel, physical door, breakfast, lunch, dinner, rain, weekend, teacher, university student, email, movie, music, photograph, internet, restaurant, water, coffee, tea, bread, cheese and a book as reading material.
decisions.lexical_unit_scope: The noun's counterpart must occur in the actual complete local translation as a unique complete native word window. These selected lexical senses may be used independently of the old example verb, person, tense or polarity. This explicitly broadens only the listed senses; it does not promote the general dictionary. Literal noun equivalence is the assessed scope. Homonyms, metaphor, names and erroneous full translations can still defeat this evidence, so native execution and external precision evaluation remain separate requirements.
decisions.meaning_equivalence: For the exact enumerated frame-topic prefixes in authored_everyday_units.py, needing food and food as nourishment denote the same noun sense; similarly financial money, the water substance, breakfast, hotel accommodation, a restaurant, electronic mail, musical sound/art, audiovisual movies, beverage coffee/tea, bread/cheese as food and reading-material books. Replacing these descriptions does not relax the old construction patterns. The old activity or request context remains in each record's usage. No other sense descriptions are merged by similarity or shared spelling.
decisions.case_forms: For these common noun surfaces only, en/es/fr/it/pt/sw receive explicit first-letter upper/lower alternatives. Accents, remaining letters, apostrophes and internal spaces are unchanged. German nouns retain their original spelling and capitalization. Arabic, Chinese, Japanese and Korean have no case transform. No inferred plural, gender alternation, stem, particle stripping or broad case-insensitive matching is approved.
decisions.grammar_scope: The selected lexical focus is the whole approved noun form, including internal links in multiword nouns. Articles, possessors, negation, person, tense and external particles stay outside. The case-adjusted carrier sentences are excluded from canonical whole-message reference lookup by whole_reference:false, preventing incidental source examples from acquiring translation authority.
decisions.forms_and_readings: Native forms and practical Latin readings come from the pinned existing authored topic sources and frame export. Arabic articles and attached possessors are not absorbed into a bare noun. Swahili locative suffixes remain outside the focus and cannot be inferred by the new standalone units. Korean attached case particles are likewise not stripped. This intentionally limits availability. All non-Roman replacement readings remain mandatory; speech still receives native text.
decisions.ambiguity_limits: Missing counterparts, repeated source/target occurrences, conflicting meanings or readings, protected literals and invalid native windows must still abstain. Unique bilingual occurrence is evidence of alignment, not proof that a local model translated the sentence correctly. Do not label availability as accuracy or these authored samples as independent acceptance.
decisions.provenance: All strings derive from existing project authoring and the pinned reviewed-frame export. No AfriWOZ or Liva evaluation utterance supplies a string. Only aggregate Liva results have been inspected. The author and assessor are the same session. Native comparison against the qualified prior bundle is required to detect regressions.
